main_text.p: 2. Meteora ignita, vel sunt magis insignia, ut fulmen, & Cometa; vel minus insignia, ut fax, lancea, Draco volans &c. Nos autem primò agemus de fulmine; secundò de Cometa, tertiò de reliquis meteoris igneis.
main_text.head: DE FULMINE.
main_text.p: 3. Fulmen est meteorum ignitum ortum ex calida & sicca exhalatione, quæ cum vapore aqueo ad mediam aëris regionem delata, ibique à vapore aut nube vehementer compressa, ac tandem accensa, nubem effringit, & sic tonitru, fulgur, ac fulmen efficitur, adeo ut tonitru sit sonus, fulgur sit splendor, & fulmen ipsa exhalatio magno impetu è nube excussa.

4. Fulmen triplex est (scilicet terebrans, discutiens, & urens: Primum est flammeum, & materiæ valde subtilis, & ideo in angustissimas rimulas corporum se insinuat: Secundum est crassum ex materia valde compacta, ideo corpora obvia disrumpit [?], illudque interdum lapis fulmineus comitatur juxta communem Philosophorum sententiam: Tertium est magis igneum quàm flammeum, ideo corpora objecta in ignem convertit.

5. Effectus fulminis præcipui sunt. Primò, fulmen interdum firmiora & magis resistentia potentius ferit; minus autem resistentibus parcit; verbi gratiâ liquefacit argentum illæsa crumena, gladium disrumpit intacta vagina, ossa diffringit incolumi carne: Tales autem effectus conveniunt fulmini terebranti ex partibus tenuissimis, sed actuosissimis composito, quod parcit rebus mollibus, porosis, & rarefactis, quales sunt cutis, caro, crumena, vagina, laurus &c. disrumpit verò dura & solida, qualia sunt argentum, ferrum, ossa &c.

6. Secundò, fulmen illæsa re solidiori fluidiorem consumit, ut cùm illæso dolio exsiccat & exhaurit vinum, qui effectus convenit fulmini terebranti composito ex partibus calidis & siccis, tenuissimis, & actuosissimis; quæ propter subtilitatem & tenuitatem transeunt per dolium porosum ipso illæso; at propter calorem & siccitatem reducunt vinum in fumos subtiles, & sic ipsum consumunt. Idem fulmen consumit substantiam cerebri humidi, illæsis partibus illis porosis capitis per quas transiit.

7. Tertiò, fulmen interdum totum dolium comburit, vino non effluente; qui effectus convenit fulmini vrenti; cum enim tunc exhalatio inflammata sit magis ignea & viscosa suam activitatem priùs exercet circa dolium, & postea ex partibus vini crassioribus & fæcibus ad superficiem evocatis formant crustam satis duram impedientem vinum ne effluat. page.notes: Doubtful readings: in the summary line "vel minus" is partly obscured by a blurred band, read as "minus" [?] (not marked in text since the word is legible). "disrumpit" in paragraph 4 is printed with a long-s-like form, read as "disrumpit" [?]. "composito" in paragraph 5 is hard to make out, read as "composito". Top of the page is shaded by the scan. Catchword "lore" is the start of the next word "calore", split at the line end. Digitiser watermark at the foot is not transcribed. Spelling normalised as per rule 5: the running head and title are printed in capitals (SECVNDA, FVLMINE), given as SECUNDA and FULMINE; consonant v in conuertit, conuenit, obuia, euocatis, vehementer, vino, vrenti kept as v; "illæso" read from "illæfo".
